mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops by more than 5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last three months signals a strengthening supply side, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% over the last three months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% each over the last month signals a strengthening demand side, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and PAYEMS both increase > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If RSAFS and PAYEMS both increase by more than 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points in the last month signals a loosening monetary policy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS drops by more than 0.25pp in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in the last month, coupled with an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000, signals a strengthening labor market, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE drops > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops by more than 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases by more than 100k in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last three months signals a weakening supply side, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% over the last three months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.
